text: The staff and parents of students attending Wilkinson Junior Public School have raised road safety concerns about Donlands Avenue. In consultation with them and Transportation Services staff, recommendations have been developed to address some road safety challenges specific to this school.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit U-turns on Donlands Avenue, between Strathmore Boulevard and Glebeholme Boulevard. 2. City Council amend the existing maximum 10 minute time-limited parking in effect from 8:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, on the east side of Donlands Avenue, between Strathmore Boulevard and a point 70 metres further north, to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays. 3.
